messages.snippet: David, Good news - the matter has settled. The executed settlement agreement is attached. Marwick pa
messages.subject: Settled - executed settlement agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
David,

Good news - the matter has settled. The executed settlement agreement is attached. Marwick pays £295,000 (£175,000 by 5 December, balance of £120,000 by 16 January) plus £28,500 towards your costs by 5 December, all without admission of liability. A Tomlin order staying the proceedings is being filed at court.

Helen - the first £175,000 plus the £28,500 costs are due into our client account by 5 December; we'll account to you on receipt.

Thank you all - and Paul in particular, whose records and statement made the difference.

Tom

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
